inventory.sourceBook: First Aid for the USMLE Step 1 2026
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: Four pure-text sections: (1) oncogenic microbes (8 microbes → cancers: EBV, HBV/HCV, HHV-8, HPV, H pylori, HTLV-1, liver fluke, Schistosoma haematobium); (2) serum tumor markers (12 markers: ALP, AFP, hCG, CA 15-3/27-29, CA 19-9, CA 125, calcitonin, CEA, chromogranin, LDH, NSE, PSA); (3) cancer testing (tumor mutational burden, MSI testing, PD-L1 expression, HRD testing, liquid biopsy); (4) IHC stains (10: chromogranin/synaptophysin, cytokeratin, desmin, GFAP, neurofilament, PSA, PECAM-1/CD-31, S-100, TRAP, vimentin) + P-glycoprotein. Pure text, no figures.
inventory.kypLocation: the registry visual (the four-section grid) + blocks[1-4] the table blocks carried verbatim

notes: The page's four text sections (oncogenic microbes, serum tumor markers, cancer testing, IHC stains) are the only visual element — pure text, no figures, no photographs (pdfimages confirmed zero rasters on both pages). Adapted as the registry visual (the four-section grid) and carried verbatim in the note's table blocks. No copyrighted photographs; nothing reproduced. No margin mnemonics; the KYP memory layer is original.
